__comment: Task scheduler tunables (doc 16 First Dwarf Milestone, §2). Loaded by the
TaskManager autoload — no other script reads this file (Registry Pattern).
JSON = what things are (the numbers); GDScript = what things do (the loop).
NO-HANG CONTRACT (doc 16 §2.5 — these keys ARE the guarantees):
scheduler_budget_usec   - hard time budget per scheduler wake; the matching
loop stops mid-scan when exceeded and resumes from
its cursor on the next wake. Overload degrades into
assignment LATENCY, never frame time.
max_probes_per_wake     - reachability probes per wake, whichever limit hits
first. Probes are the only non-trivial loop cost.
probe_node_cap          - A* expansion cap per probe (doc 32: 200). A capped
failure counts as unreachable -> backoff.
heartbeat_interval_s    - slow safety-net poll; normal operation is
event-driven wakes (task added, dwarf idle, ...).
backoff_base_s / backoff_max_s - unreachable-task retry curve:
min(backoff_base^blocked_count, backoff_max).
unreachable_signal_threshold - consecutive blocked probes before
task_unreachable fires (doc 31: 3).
static_priorities       - per-type base priority (doc 31 table). Stored on
the task at creation; colony bonuses are computed
per wake per TYPE and never written into tasks.
Keys beginning with '__' are documentation comments and are skipped.
__comment_zone: Mining work-source settings. max_workers mirrors data/terrain/mining_config.json zone.max_workers — the zone posts this many MINE leases.
